rows.en: The Battle Fleet Nation Naager's chief strategist… Apfaron the Evil Scholar!?

Sorry, Gavan! Looks like the picnic's cancelled. This is no time for me to be under arrest!

[HERO4]!! Transport me down to the surface from here!!

…………

You're determined to go, then?

Roger!! Roaring Steel, forced activation!! Molecular ejection of [HERO2]'s entire body to the target coordinates!!
H-hey… wait a minute! Whoa!!
[HERO2] vanished!? Hey, [HERO4]! Where is he?

I sent [HERO2] down to the surface the same way the armor is transported when Roaring Steel is equipped…

Gavan… please! Let him fight!! He… he has to……
Hey, something's wrong with you. Are you all right?
…The forced activation of Roaring Steel used up too much energy. I knew it would, but… not this much…
Energy!? …You're not human?

…I… I am an organic droid… built for the purpose of supporting [HERO2]…

Please… Gavan… [HERO2]… please, [HERO2]… I'm begging… you……
Hey, you! Hang in there!! [HERO4]!!

Lucifard!?

Weren't you on your way to Planet Bird with Gavan!?

Lucifard!?

Weren't you on your way to Planet Bird with Gavan!?

Lucifard!?

Weren't you supposed to be on your way to Planet Bird with Gavan…?

Lucifard!?

Weren't you supposed to be on your way to Planet Bird with Gavan…?

Lucifard!?

Weren't you supposed to be on your way to Planet Bird with Gavan…?
Everyone… Sorry, but this one is my enemy!

…!?

Lucifard, where have you been all this time? Steel Emperor Zephas is furious!!

I've been freed from that curse!

Apfaron! Now that I'm back in my right mind… I can't allow your schemes!

I've been freed from that curse!

Apfaron! Now that I'm back in my right mind… I can't allow your schemes!

Hmph… So you've broken free of Naager's control? How interesting.

Perhaps I'll bring you before Steel Emperor Zephas alive and investigate the cause…
I don't want to fight you if I can help it! Give up on Earth and go back to the "ship"!
I don't want to fight you if I can help it! Give up on Earth and go back to the "ship"!

Who do you think you're talking to? Whom do you think you owe your ability to handle Roaring Steel?

I'll break an arm or two and beat the noble spirit of Naager back into you! Roaring Steel, equip!!
What's wrong!? Lucifard? Is this the extent of the power of the man once called the Bringer of Ruin?

What!? You want to see my power that badly!?

The power that once spread terror and chaos across countless stars…

I swore I'd never use it again… but now I can unleash it on you without hesitation! My Roaring Steel's strongest technique!!

Here I come! Gravity Phantom!!

What!? You want to see my power that badly!?

The power that once spread terror and chaos across countless stars…

I swore I'd never use it again… but now I can unleash it on you without hesitation! My Roaring Steel's strongest technique!!

Here I come! Gravity Phantom!!

Ngh… I miscalculated this fighting strength…!

But… no matter how you struggle, Naager will achieve its goal! Without fail…

Damn… He got away!?

No… I should say he was kind enough to leave…

Damn… He got away!?

No… I should say he was kind enough to leave…
Why did you come back?

I…

Once, as Black Knight Lucifard, an executive of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager, I committed every atrocity imaginable…

But… that wasn't my true self! My mind was controlled by Steel Emperor Zephas…

However… when I fought Gavan at Jupiter, the damage and shock I happened to take freed me from that curse!
I heard the story from [HERO4]!

I see…

I just can't forgive Naager, infiltrating Earth's evil organizations and plotting to invade Earth without ever showing itself!

I see thwarting their schemes as the least I can do to atone for my sins…

Gavan… I'm sorry to cause you trouble yet again. But when I saw Apfaron, I couldn't just sit still, so I did what I did…
I truly can't forgive this!!
Hey, [HERO2]'s apologizing this much, isn't he!

What I'm talking about is [HERO4]!

From what I hear, this forced transport of yours uses a tremendous amount of energy, doesn't it? Look how [HERO4] is…

It's all right…

My mission is to support [HERO2]. Please, forgive [HERO2].

Even if your mind was being controlled, I have to arrest you…

But… if you regret what you've done, and you'll fight for justice…

then I'll guarantee your freedom until Naager, and the evil organizations running rampant on Earth, are wiped out.
Gavan…

And one more thing!

Treat [HERO4] better. She's a better partner than you deserve.
The mysterious organization Naager had finally begun to show itself. Lucifard was a warrior who had come to crush Naager's ambitions…
What is the true aim of Naager, quietly but surely worming its way into the evil organizations? With their bond strengthened, the warriors resolved to stand boldly against its schemes…
Ngh… Damn… I let my guard down… ugh…
Defeat all Kelbaan!
Defeat Apfaron the Evil Scholar, the Kelbaan, and all of the Shocker army and the Phantom army!
[HERO2] is defeated

Yeah… Originally, I was supposed to be posted to Earth much sooner.

But… on my way to Earth, near Jupiter, I ran into that Lucifard!

You wouldn't know it… but he's wanted by the Galactic Union Police.

I fought him in space to capture him. It was a truly fierce battle…

But… I couldn't arrest Lucifard, and my Dolgiran was half-destroyed!

So… after repairing my ship, I came to Earth all over again.
Invasion and sabotage of other planets… In other words, he's done the same things as Shocker and Makuu… that guy!!
He's disappeared from our sight… We should take it that Gavan is telling the truth.
Lucifard! I'll catch him… no matter what!!
I am not your enemy… Doctor Death, and Lord Emperor Banba. It was I who summoned you both.
I am an envoy from the Battle Fleet Nation Naager: Atefarina, the Battle Princess.

Yes… In truth, I have come to sell you weapons of invasion.

We of Naager are a people who travel from star to star across the universe, dealing in weapons we have developed ourselves.

I have come to humbly ask that you make use of our Naager's weapons for your invasion of Earth.
Now then… please enjoy the full extent of my forces.
Splendid… Truly splendid destructive power! Atefarina…
Thank you very much.

Giant Robo, eh…

Atefarina! Show me these "Kelbaan" fighters fighting Giant Robo, banbaaa!
If that is your wish…
Hmm, they were defeated… but I like the fighters' performance itself! Atefarina, what is it you want?

Merely being granted an audience with the great Shocker and the Neo-Human Empire on this occasion is an honor in itself…

Therefore… I intend to present these weapons free of charge, as a token of our acquaintance.

So these are the ones who get in your way?

Please leave this to me. I had been hoping for a chance to cross swords with them…
Yes…
[HERO2]!? Where have you been?
[HERO2]!? Where have you been?
[HERO2]!? Where have you been?
[HERO2]!? Where have you been?
[HERO2]!? Where have you been?

We'll talk later!

More importantly… Atefarina! Sorry, but this one is my enemy!
[HERO2], I've finally found you! Now, you're coming back with us. Steel Emperor Zephas is waiting for you!!

I've been freed from that curse!

Atefarina! Now that I'm back in my right mind… I can't allow your schemes!

I've been freed from that curse!

Atefarina! Now that I'm back in my right mind… I can't allow your schemes!

…!? You mean you've broken free of Naager's control?

Then I'll need to bring you before Steel Emperor Zephas alive and investigate the cause, won't I?
I don't want to fight you if I can help it! Give up on Earth and go back to the "ship"!

Who do you think you're talking to? They don't call me the Battle Princess for nothing!

I'll break an arm or two and beat the noble spirit of Naager back into you, won't I just! Roaring Steel, equip!!

Prepare yourself!! I'm taking you back with me, even if I have to use force!

Now, Fadita! Receive the command of your creator. To the great Naager…

Shutdown program activated…

Accepted with priority over all other commands! …Function… stopping…!

Shutdown program activated…

Accepted with priority over all other commands! …Function… stopping…!

[HERO4]!?

Atefarina! What did you do to her!?

[HERO4]!?

Atefarina! What did you do to her!?
